visualCharacteristics.structure: tabs + thematic image + product cards (image + brand + title + price + rating + add to cart)

contentPattern.structure: One block instance per tab. Row 1 = thematic panel: cell 1 = Gift Zone image, cell 2 = tab label as heading ("Gift Zone") + "Shop All" link. Rows 2..13 = products: cell 1 = product image, cell 2 = brand (bold) + title (linked to PDP), price, was-price (strikethrough) + savings, rating/review count, social-proof text, "Add to Cart" link. Consecutive instances in the section form the tab bar ("Gift Zone", "Top Deals").
